title: History 16: What open means: weights, licences and the ecosystem

questions.q: You can download a model's weights but not its training code or data details. Which can you do?
options: Run it on your own machine
questions.answer: Run it on your own machine
questions.why: Weights let you run it. Rebuilding needs code and data information.

questions.q: What is the honest phrase when all you have is downloadable weights?
questions.why: It says what you have. Other words claim more than that.

questions.q: A graph uses ComfyUI, a checkpoint and a LoRA. How many sets of terms are in play?
options: At least three, one for each
One, ComfyUI's GPL covers them all
questions.answer: At least three, one for each
questions.why: Each came from a different source on its own terms.

questions.q: Does readable code mean a custom node is safe?
options: No, it means you can check it
Yes, open code is reviewed code
questions.answer: No, it means you can check it
questions.why: ComfyUI's SECURITY.md calls custom nodes arbitrary Python code.

questions.q: What is the notable feature of CreativeML Open RAIL-M?
options: Broad use with a written list of banned uses you must pass on
It forbids all commercial use by name
It requires you to publish weights
questions.answer: Broad use with a written list of banned uses you must pass on
questions.why: Paragraphs 4 and 5 and Attachment A say so.
